title: Data center backlash is uniting America
script:
Data centers are now uniting American voters across the country in unexpected ways.
The rapid buildout of massive server storage facilities has sparked intense local opposition.
Communities are fighting back against the heavy infrastructure construction and the huge expenses that come with them.
This local pushback has officially become a major issue in many upcoming congressional races.
Will your representative support or block the next facility?
